How to add a freetext annotation as typewriter

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add freetext annotation, as type writer.
 annots::FreeText freetext(page.AddAnnot(annots::Annot::e_FreeText,RectF(10,550,200,600)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4);
 // Set default appearance
 foxit::pdf::DefaultAppearance default_ap;
 default_ap.flags = DefaultAppearance::e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance::e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance::e_FlagTextColor;
 default_ap.font = common::Font(common::Font::e_StdIDHelvetica);
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 // Set default appearance for form.
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap);
 freetext.SetIntent("FreeTextTypewriter");
 freetext.SetContent(L"A typewriter annotation");
 freetext.SetSubject(L"FreeTextTypewriter");
 freetext.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 // Appearance must be reset.
 freetext.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a typewriter freetext annotation." << endl;
 }

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to add text field with flag comb
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/interform/fs_pdfform.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;
using namespace actions;
using namespace interform;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc;
 interform::Form form(doc);
 // Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0);

 // Add text field with flag comb
 Control control = form.AddControl(page, L"Text Field3", Field::e_TypeTextField, RectF(50, 570, 100, 590));
 Field field = control.GetField();
 uint32 flag = Field::e_FlagTextComb;
 field.SetFlags(flag);
 field.SetValue(L"94538");
 field.SetMaxLength(5);
 // Update text field's appearance.
 control.GetWidget().ResetAppearanceStream();
 Library::Release();
}

How to add a link annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add link annotation
 annots::Link link(page.AddAnnot(annots::Annot::e_Link, RectF(350,350,380,400)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 link.SetFlags(4);
 link.SetHighlightingMode(annots::Annot::e_HighlightingPush);

 // Add action for link annotation
 using foxit::pdf::actions::Action;
 using foxit::pdf::actions::URIAction;
 URIAction action = (URIAction)Action::Create(page.GetDocument(), Action::e_TypeURI);
 action.SetTrackPositionFlag(true);
 action.SetURI("www.foxitsoftware.com");
 link.SetAction(action);
 link.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a link annotation." << endl;
 }

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

How to add table to a PDF document

#include "include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "include/addon/tablegenerator/fs_tablegenerator.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void AddElectronicTable(PDFPage &page) {
 //Add a spreadsheet with 5 rows and 6 columns
 {
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableCellDataArray cell_array;
 WString cell_text = L" ";
 for (int row = 0; row < 5; row++) {
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableCellDataColArray col_array;
 for (int col = 0; col < 6; col++) {
 foxit::pdf::RichTextStyle style = GetTableTextStyle(row);
 switch (col) {
 case 0:
 cell_text.Format(L"First column");
 break;
 case 1:
 cell_text.Format(L"Second column");
 break;
 case 2:
 cell_text.Format(L"Third column");
 break;
 case 3:
 cell_text.Format(L"Fourth column");
 break;
 case 4:
 cell_text.Format(L"Fifth column");
 break;
 case 5:
 cell_text = DateTimeToString(GetLocalDateTime());
 break;
 default:
 cell_text = L" ";
 break;
 }
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableCellData cell_data(style, cell_text, foxit::common::Image((FS_HANDLE)NULL), RectF());
 col_array.Add(cell_data);
 }
 cell_array.Add(col_array);
 }

 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableBorderInfo outside_border_left;
 outside_border_left.line_width = 2;
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableBorderInfo outside_border_right;
 outside_border_right.line_width = 2;
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableBorderInfo outside_border_top;
 outside_border_top.line_width = 2;
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableBorderInfo outside_border_bottom;
 outside_border_bottom.line_width = 2;

 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableBorderInfo inside_border_row;
 inside_border_row.line_width = 2;
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableBorderInfo inside_border_col;
 inside_border_col.line_width = 2;
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableData data(RectF(10, 200, page.GetWidth()- 10, page.GetHeight()- 350), 5, 6, outside_border_left, outside_border_right, outside_border_top, outside_border_bottom, inside_border_row, inside_border_col, foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableCellIndexArray(), FloatArray(), FloatArray());
 foxit::addon::tablegenerator::TableGenerator::AddTableToPage(page, data, cell_array);
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc();
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0);
 AddElectronicTable(page);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

How to generate barcode

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_barcode.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void Save2Image(Bitmap& bitmap, WString bmp_name)
{
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);

 image.SaveAs(bmp_name);
}

// Generate barcode in different type and save each of them as an image file.
void Barcode_GenerateEachType(WString code_string, Barcode::Format code_format, int unit_width, int unit_height, Barcode::QRErrorCorrectionLevel qr_level, WString bmp_name)
{
 Barcode barcode;
 Bitmap bitmap = barcode.GenerateBitmap(code_string, code_format, unit_width, unit_height, qr_level);

 Save2Image(bitmap, bmp_name);
}

// Generate all types of barcode and save each of them as an image file.
void Barcode_GenerateAll( )
{
 // Strings used as barcode content.
 WString sz_code_string[8] = {L"TEST-SHEET", L"102030405060708090", L"80674313", L"890444000335", L"9780804816632", L"070429", L"Unknown - change me!", L"TestForBarcodeQrCode"};
 // Barcode format types
 Barcode::Format code_format[8] = {Barcode::e_FormatCode39, Barcode::e_FormatCode128,
 Barcode::e_FormatEAN8, Barcode::e_FormatUPCA,
 Barcode::e_FormatEAN13, Barcode::e_FormatITF,
 Barcode::e_FormatPDF417, Barcode::e_FormatQRCode};

 // Image names for the saved image files.(except QR code)
 WString sz_bmp_name[7] = {L"/code39_TEST-SHEET.bmp", L"/CODE_128_102030405060708090.bmp",
 L"/EAN_8_80674313.bmp", L"/UPC_A_890444000335.bmp", L"/EAN_13_9780804816632.bmp",
 L"/ITF_070429.bmp", L"/PDF_417_Unknown.bmp"};

 //Format error correction level of QR code.
 Barcode::QRErrorCorrectionLevel sz_qr_level[4] = {Barcode::e_QRCorrectionLevelLow, Barcode::e_QRCorrectionLevelMedium,
 Barcode::e_QRCorrectionLevelQuater, Barcode::e_QRCorrectionLevelHigh};
 //Image names for the saved image files for QR code.
 WString bmp_qr_name[4] = {L"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_L.bmp", L"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_M.bmp",
 L"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_Q.bmp", L"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_H.bmp"};

 // Unit width for barcode in pixels, preferred value is 1-5 pixels.
 int unit_width = 2;
 // Unit height for barcode in pixels, preferred value is >= 20 pixels.
 int unit_height = 120;

 // Generate barcode for different types.
 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
 {
 if (code_format[i] != Barcode::e_FormatQRCode) {
 // Not QR code
 Barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_string[i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, (Barcode::QRErrorCorrectionLevel)0, sz_bmp_name[i]);
 } else {
 // QR code
 //Generate for each format error correction level.
 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
 Barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_string[i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, sz_qr_level[j], bmp_qr_name[j]);
 }
 }
}
int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;

 Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 // Generate all types of barcode
 Barcode_GenerateAll();
 }

 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to search and replace text
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/pageeditor/fs_searchreplace.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::addon::pageeditor;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"SearchReplaceText.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 TextSearchReplace text_searchreplace(doc);
 FindOption find_option(true, true);
 text_searchreplace.SetPattern(L"PDF", 0, find_option);
 while (text_searchreplace.ReplaceNext(L"PDC")) {}

 doc.SaveAs(L"SearchReplaceTextResult.pdf");
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to add a square annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here

{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 // Add square annotation

how to create mark content
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/objects/fs_pdfobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace graphics;
using namespace objects;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void CreateMarkedContent(PDFPage page) {
 POSITION position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypeText);
 TextObject* text_object = TextObject::Create();

 text_object->SetFillColor(0xFF83AF9B);

 // Prepare text state
 TextState state;
 state.font_size = 72.f;
 state.font = Font(Font::e_StdIDTimesB);
 state.textmode = TextState::e_ModeFill;

 text_object->SetTextState(page, state, false, 750);

 text_object->SetText(L"Marked-Content");
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, text_object);

 RectF rect = text_object->GetRect();
 float offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.618f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 text_object->Transform(Matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 MarkedContent* content = text_object->GetMarkedContent();
 PDFDictionary* span_dict = PDFDictionary::Create();
 span_dict->SetAtInteger("Direct", 55);
 content->AddItem("Span", span_dict);
 span_dict->Release();
 // Generate content
 page.GenerateContent();
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc;
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load();
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0);
 CreateMarkedContent(page);

 Library::Release();
}

how to add header and footer
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_headerfooter.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc(L"HeaderFooter.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 HeaderFooter headerfooter = doc.GetEditableHeaderFooter();
 // Add header-footer
 headerfooter.text_color = 0x00FFFF;
 headerfooter.page_range = PageNumberRange(1, doc.GetPageCount(), foxit::common::Range::e_Odd);
 headerfooter.has_fixedsize_for_print = false;
 headerfooter.has_text_shrinked = false;
 headerfooter.start_page_number = 2;
 headerfooter.page_margin = RectF(36, 70, 36, 70);
 headerfooter.text_size = 8;
 doc.AddHeaderFooter(headerfooter);
 doc.SaveAs(L"HeaderFooter_AddHeaderFooter.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to adds a new PDF page to document, from a named template.

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/actions/fs_action.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/objects/fs_pdfnametree.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::objects;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 SdkLibMgr sdk_lib_mgr;
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = sdk_lib_mgr.Initialize();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 try {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"D:/test.pdf");
 doc.Load();
 PDFNameTree templates_name_tree(doc, PDFNameTree::e_Templates);
 if (templates_name_tree.HasName(L"Page3")) {
 doc.AddPageFromTemplate(L"Page3");
 }
 doc.SaveAs("D:/test_add_template.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 catch (const Exception& e) {
 cout << e.GetMessage() << endl;
 err_ret = 1;
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

How to add a underline annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 // Add underline annotation.
 annots::Underline underline(page.AddAnnot(annots::Annot::e_Underline,RectF(100,450,200,550)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 underline.SetFlags(4);
 annots::QuadPoints quad_points;
 quad_points.first = PointF(110, 500);
 quad_points.second = PointF(190, 500);
 quad_points.third = PointF(110, 480);
 quad_points.fourth = PointF(190, 480);
 annots::QuadPointsArray quad_points_array;
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 underline.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 underline.SetSubject(L"Underline");
 underline.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 underline.SetCreationDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 underline.SetModifiedDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 // Appearance must be reset.
 underline.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a underline annotation." << endl;

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

How to associate file to annotation dictionary?
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfassociatefiles.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::objects;
using namespace pdf::annots;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 PDFDoc doc("Simple.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 AssociatedFiles associated_files(doc);

 //Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt(doc);
 filespec_txt.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles::e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.SetFileName(L"1.txt");
 DateTime dateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0);
 filespec_txt.SetDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.Embed(L"1.txt");
 filespec_txt.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetSubtype();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 RectF rect(100, 50, 220, 100);
 Annot annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot::e_Note, rect);
 annot.ResetAppearanceStream();
 associated_files.AssociateFile(annot, filespec_txt);

 WString newPdf = L"newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to make multiple signatures share signature data.
// Include Foxit SDK header files.

#include "../../../include/common/fs_basictypes.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_signature.h"

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
if (code != e_ErrSuccess)return 1;

PDFDoc doc(L"blank.pdf");
code = doc.Load();
if (code != e_ErrSuccess)
return 1;
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 RectF sigRect;
 sigRect.left = 0;
 sigRect.bottom = 400;
 sigRect.right = 200;
 sigRect.top = 475;
 Signature pNewSig = page.AddSignature(sigRect);
 pNewSig.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameSigner, L"Neko");
 pNewSig.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameReason, L"For test");
 pNewSig.GenerateAppearance();
 sigRect.left = 200;
 sigRect.bottom = 200;
 sigRect.right = 400;
 sigRect.top = 275;
 Signature sign1 = page.AddSignatureWithExistedVDict(sigRect, L"test1", Signature::e_SignatureTypeOrdinary, false, pNewSig);
 sign1.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameSigner, L"Jack");
 sign1.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameReason, L"For test GSDK");
 sign1.GenerateAppearance();
 pNewSig.StartSign(L"foxit_all.pfx", L"123456", Signature::e_DigestSHA1, L"Signed.pdf");
Library::Release();
}

---

how to layout recognition information
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/layoutrecognition/fs_layoutrecognition.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;
using namespace actions;
using namespace interform;
using namespace foxit::addon::layoutrecognition;
using namespace foxit::pdf::objects;
using namespace foxit::pdf::graphics;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

typedef CFX_ArrayTemplate<LRElement> LRElementArray;
void GetChildFromElement(LRStructureElement pElement, LRElementArray& elemArray,
 LRStructureElement::ElementType nType) {
 int nElemListSize = pElement.GetChildCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nElemListSize; i++) {
 LRElement item = pElement.GetChild(i);
 LRElement::ElementType item_type = item.GetElementType();
 if (item_type == nType)
 elemArray.Add(item);
 if (item.IsStructureElement()) {
 LRStructureElement srt_item(item);
 GetChildFromElement(srt_item, elemArray, nType);
 }
 }
}

void OutputAllLRElement(LRStructureElement element, const WString& info_path) {
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 WString input_file = L"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 WString info_file = L"layout_recognition_info.txt";

 PDFDoc doc(input_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 printf("The Doc [%s] Error: %d\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(input_file), error_code);
 return 1;
 }

 LRContext context(doc.GetPage(0));

 Progressive progressive = context.StartParse(NULL);

 LRStructureElement root = context.GetRootElement();
 LRStructureElement::ElementType type = root.GetElementType();
 int nElemListSize = root.GetChildCount();
 cout << "RootElement GetChildCount: " << nElemListSize << endl;

 OutputAllLRElement(root, info_file);
 LRElementArray element_array;
 GetChildFromElement(root, element_array, LRStructureElement::e_ElementTypeSpan);
 cout << "LRElement::e_ElementTypeSpan count: " << element_array.GetSize() << endl;

 Library::Release();
}

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of insert type
#include <time.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_search.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/comparison/fs_compare.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fxcrt/fx_basic.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace common;
using namespace addon;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::pdf::annots;
using namespace foxit::addon::comparison;

void CreateInsertStamp(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, RGB color, WString ws_contents, WString ws_type, WString ws_obj_type) {
 RectF rect_stamp;
 int rect_size = rects.GetSize();
 if (rect_size > 0) {
 RectF item = rects.GetAt(0);
 rect_stamp.left = item.left;
 rect_stamp.top = item.top - 4;
 rect_stamp.right = rect_stamp.left + 4;
 rect_stamp.bottom = rect_stamp.top - 8;
 }

 Image image = Image(L"insert_stamp.png");

 annots::Stamp stamp(page.AddAnnot(Annot::e_Stamp, rect_stamp));
 stamp.SetContent(ws_contents);
 stamp.SetBorderColor(color);
 stamp.SetSubject(ws_obj_type);
 stamp.SetTitle(ws_type);
 stamp.SetImage(image, 0, 0);

 stamp.ResetAppearanceStream();
}
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc base_doc(L"test_base.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = base_doc.Load();
 PDFDoc compared_doc(L"test_compared.pdf");
 error_code = compared_doc.Load();
 Comparison comparison(base_doc, compared_doc);

 // Start comparing.
 CompareResults result = comparison.DoCompare(0, 0, Comparison::e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray& old_info = result.base_doc_results;
 CompareResultInfoArray& new_info = result.compared_doc_results;
 int old_info_size = old_info.GetSize();
 PDFPage page_base = base_doc.GetPage(0);
 for (int i = 0; i < old_info_size; i++) {
 const CompareResultInfo& item = old_info.GetAt(i);
 CompareResultInfo::CompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == CompareResultInfo::e_CompareResultTypeDeleteText) {
 String res_string;
 res_string.Format((FX_LPCSTR)"\"%s\"", (FX_LPCSTR)String::FromUnicode(item.diff_contents));
 // Add stamp to mark the "insert" type differences between the two documents
 CreateInsertStamp(page_base, item.rect_array, 0x0000ff, WString::FromLocal(res_string), L"Compare : Insert", L"Text");
 }
 }
 base_doc.SaveAs(L"Insert_result.pdf");

 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to update header footer
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_headerfooter.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc(L"HeaderFooter.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 HeaderFooter headerfooter = doc.GetEditableHeaderFooter();
 // Update header-footer
 HeaderFooterContentGenerator contentgenerator;
 contentgenerator.AddDate(HeaderFooterContentGenerator::e_DateFormatMSlashDSlashYYYY);
 contentgenerator.AddString(L" foxit");
 HeaderFooterContent content = headerfooter.content;
 content.header_right_content = contentgenerator.GenerateContent();
 headerfooter.content = content;
 doc.UpdateHeaderFooter(headerfooter);
 doc.SaveAs(L"HeaderFooter_UpdateHeaderFooter.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to import page
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace graphics;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

bool ImportPage() {
 WString file_dest = L"page_organization_123.pdf";
 WString file_src = L"page_organization_abc.pdf";
 PDFDoc doc_dest = PDFDoc(file_dest);
 ErrorCode code = doc_dest.Load();
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 PDFDoc doc_src = PDFDoc(file_src);
 code = doc_src.Load();
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 // Import page from PDFDoc object.
 Range import_ranges(0);
 import_ranges.AddSingle(doc_src.GetPageCount() - 1);
 Progressive progressive =
 doc_dest.StartImportPages(-1, doc_src, PDFDoc::e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc", import_ranges, NULL);
 while (progressive.Continue() != Progressive::e_Finished) {
 }
 doc_dest.SaveAs(L"result1.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNormal);

 doc_dest = PDFDoc(file_dest);
 code = doc_dest.Load();
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 // Import page from file path.
 progressive = doc_dest.StartImportPagesFromFilePath(-1, file_src, "", PDFDoc::e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc",
 import_ranges, NULL);
 while (progressive.Continue() != Progressive::e_Finished) {
 }
 doc_dest.SaveAs(L"result.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNormal);
 return true;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 ImportPage();
 }

 Library::Release();
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add table of contents to PDF file.
// Include Foxit SDK header files.

#include "../../../include/fs_basictypes.h"
#include "../../../include/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/fs_pdfdoc.h"

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
if (code != e_ErrSuccess)return 1;

PDFDoc doc(L"Bookmark.pdf");
code = doc.Load();
if (code != e_ErrSuccess)
return 1;
 TableOfContentsConfig toc_config;
 toc_config.include_toc_pages = false;
 toc_config.title = L"Table of Contents";
 toc_config.is_show_serial_number = true;
 Int32Array intarray;
 int depth = doc.GetBookmarkLevelDepth();
 if (depth > 0) {
 if (depth > 5) depth = 5;
 for (int i = 1; i <= depth; i++) {
 intarray.Add(i);
 }
 }
 toc_config.bookmark_level_array = intarray;
 doc.AddTableOfContents(toc_config);
 doc.SaveAs(L"TOC.pdf");
Library::Release();
}

How to add a screen annotation
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include<direct.h>

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/actions/fs_action.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_signature.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/fs_actioncallback.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/objects/fs_pdfobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_psi.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;
using foxit::pdf::annots::Line;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 {
 //Add screen annotation
 Image image = Image(L"FoxitLogo.jpg");
 annots::Screen screen(page.AddAnnot(Annot::e_Screen, RectF(300, 150, 400, 200)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 screen.SetFlags(4);
 screen.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 screen.SetBorderColor(0x0000FF);
 screen.SetBorderInfo(BorderInfo(2, BorderInfo::e_Solid, 0, 0, FloatArray()));
 screen.SetImage(image, 0, true);

 // Prepare rendition action
 using foxit::pdf::actions::Action;
 using foxit::pdf::actions::RenditionAction;
 RenditionAction rendition_action = RenditionAction(Action::Create(page.GetDocument(), Action::e_TypeRendition));

 rendition_action.SetOperationType(RenditionAction::e_OpTypeAssociate);
 rendition_action.SetScreenAnnot(screen);

 // Prepare rendition
 Rendition rendition(page.GetDocument());

 rendition.SetRenditionName(L"screen for rendition");
 rendition.SetMediaClipName(L"ytb210-Mopa.mp4");
 rendition.SetPermission(Rendition::e_MediaPermTempAccess);
 FileSpec video_filespec(page.GetDocument());
 video_filespec.SetFileName(L"ytb210-Mopa.mp4");
 WString video_file_path = L"ytb210-Mopa.mp4";

 video_filespec.Embed(video_file_path);
 rendition.SetMediaClipFile(video_filespec);
 rendition.SetMediaClipContentType("video/mp4");

 rendition_action.InsertRendition(rendition);

 screen.SetAction(rendition_action);

 screen.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a screen annotation." << endl;
 }

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to edit layer tree
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_render.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdflayer.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc(L"OCTest_src.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 // Edit layer tree
 LayerTree layertree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.GetRootNode();
 int children_count = root.GetChildrenCount();
 root.RemoveChild(children_count - 1);
 LayerNode child = root.GetChild(children_count - 2);
 LayerNode child0 = root.GetChild(0);
 child.MoveTo(child0, 0);
 child.AddChild(0, L"AddedLayerNode", true);
 child.AddChild(0, L"AddedNode", false);
 doc.SaveAs(L"edit_layer_tree.pdf");
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to add new signature

#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_signature.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace objects;
using namespace file;

#include "../../../include/openssl/rsa.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/evp.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/objects.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/x509.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/err.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pem.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/ssl.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs12.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/rand.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs7.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/stack.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/ts.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs7.h"

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc pdf_doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(NULL, false, NULL);

 PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0);
 // Add a new signature to first page.
 Signature new_signature = pdf_page.AddSignature(RectF(1, 1, 101, 101));
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameSigner, L"Foxit PDF SDK");

 // Set filter and subfilter for the new signature.
 new_signature.SetFilter("Adobe.PPKLite");
 new_signature.SetSubFilter("adbe.pkcs7.detached");

 // Sign the new signature.
 new_signature.StartSign(L"foxit_all.pfx", L"123456",
 Signature::e_DigestSHA1, L"signed_newsignature.pdf", NULL, NULL);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to get first child of bookmark and change its properties?

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"

static const char* key = "";

{

 Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 //Get bookmark root node or Create new bookmark root node.
 Bookmark root = doc.GetRootBookmark();
 // Get first bookmark and change properties.

how to ocr pdf page
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/ocr/fs_ocr.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace addon::ocr;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 {
 WString ocr_resource_path = L"";
 code = OCREngine::Initialize(ocr_resource_path);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 // Set languages.
 OCREngine::SetLanguages(L"English");

 // OCR PDF page, only for search, not editable.
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit_ocr.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 OCR ocr_operator;
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFPage(page, false);

 WString save_pdf_path = L"ocr_page_searchable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 // OCR PDF page, editable.
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit_ocr.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 OCR ocr_operator;
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFPage(page, true);

 WString save_pdf_path = L"ocr_page_editable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 OCREngine::Release();
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to convert office file to pdf
#include<string.h>
#include<direct.h>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/conversion/fs_convert.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 // Conver Word file to PDF file.
 WString word_file_path = L"AboutFoxit.doc";
 WString output_path = L"word2pdf_result.pdf";
 // Use default Word2PDFSettingData values.
 foxit::addon::conversion::Word2PDFSettingData word_convert_setting_data;
 foxit::addon::conversion::Convert::FromWord(word_file_path, L"", output_path, word_convert_setting_data);

 // Conver Excel file to PDF file.
 WString excel_file_path = L"test.xlsx";
 output_path = L"excel2pdf_result.pdf";
 // Use default Excel2PDFSettingData values.
 foxit::addon::conversion::Excel2PDFSettingData excel_convert_setting_data;
 foxit::addon::conversion::Convert::FromExcel(excel_file_path, L"", output_path, excel_convert_setting_data);

 // Conver PowerPoint file to PDF file.

 output_path = L"ppt2pdf_result.pdf";
 // Use default PowerPoint2PDFSettingData values.
 foxit::addon::conversion::PowerPoint2PDFSettingData ppt_convert_setting_data;
 foxit::addon::conversion::Convert::FromPowerPoint(ppt_file_path, L"", output_path, ppt_convert_setting_data);
 Library::Release();
}

How to get all annotations in all pages?
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace common;
using namespace pdf;

const char* sn = "";
const char* key = "";

void main() {
	Library::Initialize(sn, key);

	{
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load("123");
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 cout << "Load document error!" << endl;
 }
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 int annot_count = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < annot_count; j++) {
 pdf::annots::Annot annot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 }
 }
	}

	Library::Release();
}

how to convert image file to pdf
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::graphics;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void Image2PDF(WString input_file, WString output_file)
{
 Image image(input_file);
 int count = 1;
 if (image.GetType() != Image::e_JBIG2) {
 count = image.GetFrameCount();
 }
 PDFDoc doc;
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(i, image.GetWidth(), image.GetHeight());
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 // Add image to page
 page.AddImage(image, i, PointF(0, 0), image.GetWidth(), image.GetHeight(), true);
 }

}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Convert .bmp file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"watermark.bmp";
 WString output_file = L"watermark_bmp.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 {
 // Convert .jpg file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"image_samples.jpg";
 WString output_file = L"image_samples_jpg.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 }
 {
 // Convert .tif file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"TIF2Pages.tif";
 WString output_file = L"TIF2Pages_tif.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 }
 {
 // Convert .gif file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"image005.gif";
 WString output_file = L"image005_gif.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 }
 {
 // Convert .png file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"1.png";
 WString output_file = L"1_png.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 }
 {
 // Convert .jb2 file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"STR_039.jb2";
 WString output_file = L"STR_039_jb2.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 }
 {
 // Convert .jp2 file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"1.jp2";
 WString output_file = L"1_jp2.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 }
 {
 // Convert .jpx file to PDF document.
 WString input_file = L"1.jpx";
 WString output_file = L"1_jpx.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 Library::Release();
 }
}

how to Convert PDF file to PDFA - 1a version
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_compliancecommon.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfa.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfcompliance.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace addon;
using namespace compliance;

// user enters the sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine::Initialize(L" ", "");
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 switch (error_code) {
 case foxit::e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 printf("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.\n");
 break;
 default:
 printf("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: %d\n", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return 1;
 }
 cout << "ComplianceEngine is initialized." << endl;

 PDFACompliance pdfa_compliance;

 WString save_pdf_path = L"3_pdfacompliance_convert_to_pdf1a.pdf";
 {
 // Convert original PDF file to PDFA-1a version.
 ResultInformation convert_result_info = pdfa_compliance.ConvertPDFFile(L"AboutFoxit.pdf", save_pdf_path,
 PDFACompliance::e_VersionPDFA1a, NULL);
 }

 // Release compliance engine.
 ComplianceEngine::Release();
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to add a highlight annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 // Add highlight annotation.
 annots::Highlight highlight(page.AddAnnot(annots::Annot::e_Highlight,RectF(10,450,100,550)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 highlight.SetFlags(4);
 highlight.SetContent(L"Highlight");
 annots::QuadPoints quad_points;
 quad_points.first = PointF(10, 500);
 quad_points.second = PointF(90, 500);
 quad_points.third = PointF(10, 480);
 quad_points.fourth = PointF(90, 480);
 annots::QuadPointsArray quad_points_array;
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 highlight.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 highlight.SetSubject(L"Highlight");
 highlight.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 highlight.SetCreationDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 highlight.SetModifiedDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());

 // Appearance should be reset.
 highlight.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a highlight annotation." << endl;

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to set information into doc
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdocviewerprefs.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfmetadata.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace common;
using namespace graphics;
using namespace objects;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void SetDocViewerPrefsInfo(PDFDoc doc) {

 doc.SetDisplayMode(PDFDoc::e_DisplayFullScreen);
 DocViewerPrefs prefs(doc);
 // Set UI visibility status.
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kUIItems) / (sizeof(kUIItems[0])); i++) {
 prefs.SetUIDisplayStatus(kUIItems[i], true);
 }
 // Set display mode for non full-screen mode.
 prefs.SetNonFullScreenPageMode(PDFDoc::e_DisplayUseOutlines);
 // Set reading direction.
 prefs.SetReadingDirection(false);
 // Set the type of area item.

 prefs.SetViewArea(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_CropBox);
 prefs.SetViewClip(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_CropBox);
 prefs.SetPrintArea(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_CropBox);
 prefs.SetPrintClip(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_CropBox);
 // Set page scaling option.
 prefs.SetPrintScale(DocViewerPrefs::e_PrintScaleNone);
 // Set the number of copies to be printed.
 prefs.SetPrintCopies(4);
 common::Range print_range(0, doc.GetPageCount() / 2);
 prefs.SetPrintRange(print_range);
}

void SetMetaDataInfo(PDFDoc doc) {

 const wchar_t* kMetadataValues[] = { L"Title set by simple demo", L"Simple demo",
 L"Subject set by simple demo", L"Keywords set by simple demo",
 L"Foxit PDF SDK", L"Foxit" };
 Metadata metadata(doc);
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kMetadataValues) / sizeof(kMetadataValues[0]); i++) {
 foxit::WStringArray MetadataValues;
 MetadataValues.Add(kMetadataValues[i]);
 metadata.SetValues(kMetadataItems[i], MetadataValues);
 }
 metadata.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 metadata.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 WString input_file = L"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 PDFDoc doc(input_file);
 doc.Load();
 // Set information.
 SetDocViewerPrefsInfo(doc);
 SetMetaDataInfo(doc);

 Library::Release();
}

how to optimize pdf file by clean up redundant date
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/optimization/fs_optimization.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::addon;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc(L"Cleanup.pdf");;
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 addon::optimization::OptimizerSettings settings;
 settings.SetOptimizerOptions(foxit::addon::optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_OptimizerCleanUp);
 settings.SetCleanUpOptions(optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_CleanUpRemoveInvalidBookmarks | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_CleanUpRemoveInvalidLinks
 | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_CleanUpUseFlateForNonEncodedStream | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_CleanUpUseFlateInsteadOfLZW);
 common::Progressive progressive = addon::optimization::Optimizer::Optimize(doc, settings, NULL);
 Progressive::State progress_state = Progressive::e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive::e_ToBeContinued == progress_state) {
 progress_state = progressive.Continue();
 int percent = progressive.GetRateOfProgress();
 String res_string;
 res_string.Format("Optimize progress percent: %d %", percent);
 std::cout << res_string << std::endl;
 }
 if (Progressive::e_Finished == progress_state) {
 doc.SaveAs(L"Cleanup_Optimized.pdf", foxit::pdf::PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects);
 }

 Library::Release();
}

---

how to convert pdf file to text file
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_search.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 interform::Form form(doc);
 FILE* file = NULL;

 fopen_s(&file, (const char*)String::FromUnicode(L"AboutFoxit.txt"), "wb+");
 // Get page count
 int nPageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nPageCount; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 // Get the text page object.
 TextPage text_page(page);
 int count = text_page.GetCharCount();
 if (count > 0) {
 WString text = text_page.GetChars();
 String s_text = text.UTF8Encode();
 fwrite((const char*)s_text, sizeof(char), s_text.GetLength(), file);
 }
 }
 fclose(file);

 Library::Release();
 }

how to ocr pdf document
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"

using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace addon::ocr;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 WString ocr_resource_path = L"";
 code = OCREngine::Initialize(ocr_resource_path);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 // Set languages.
 OCREngine::SetLanguages(L"English");

 // OCR PDF document, only for search, not editable.
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit_ocr.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 OCR ocr_operator;
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFDocument(doc, false);

 WString save_pdf_path = L"ocr_doc_searchable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 // OCR PDF document, editable.
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit_ocr.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 OCR ocr_operator;
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFDocument(doc, true);

 WString save_pdf_path = L"ocr_doc_editable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 OCREngine::Release();
 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

how to add path into pdf page
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace graphics;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void AddPieces(PDFPage page, ShadingObject* orignal_pieces, const RectF& dst_rect) {
 POSITION position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypeAll);
 ShadingObject* pieces = (ShadingObject*)orignal_pieces->Clone();

 RectF piece_rect = pieces->GetRect();

 // Calculates the transformation matrix between dst_rect and piece_rect.
 float a = (dst_rect.right - dst_rect.left) / (piece_rect.right - piece_rect.left);
 float d = (dst_rect.top - dst_rect.bottom) / (piece_rect.top - piece_rect.bottom);
 float e = dst_rect.left - piece_rect.left * a;
 float f = dst_rect.top - piece_rect.top * d;

 // Transform rect.
 pieces->Transform(Matrix(a, 0, 0, d, e, f), false);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, pieces);

 page.GenerateContent();
}

void AddPathObjects(PDFPage page, ShadingObject* black_pieces, ShadingObject* white_pieces) {
 POSITION position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypePath);
 PathObject* path_object = PathObject::Create();
 Path path;
 float page_width = page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = page.GetHeight();

 float width = min(page_width, page_height) / 20.0f;
 float start_x = (page_width - width * 18.0f) / 2.0f;
 float start_y = (page_height - width * 18.0f) / 2.0f;

 // Draw a chess board
 for (int i = 0; i < 19; i++) {
 float x1 = start_x;
 float y1 = i * width + start_y;

 float x2 = start_x + 18 * width;
 path.MoveTo(PointF(x1, y1));
 path.LineTo(PointF(x2, y1));

 x1 = i * width + start_x;
 y1 = start_y;

 float y2 = 18 * width + start_y;
 path.MoveTo(PointF(x1, y1));
 path.LineTo(PointF(x1, y2));
 }

 int star[3] = { 3, 9, 15 };
 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
 RectF rect(start_x + star[i] * width - width / 12, start_y + star[j] * width - width / 12,
 start_x + star[i] * width + width / 12, start_y + star[j] * width + width / 12);
 path.AppendEllipse(rect);
 }
 }
 path_object->SetPathData(path);

 path_object->SetFillColor(0xFF000000);
 path_object->SetFillMode(e_FillModeAlternate);
 path_object->SetStrokeState(true);
 path_object->SetStrokeColor(0xFF000000);

 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, path_object);
 page.GenerateContent();

 // Draw pieces
 PointF pieces_vector[2][8] = { {PointF(3, 3), PointF(3, 7), PointF(3, 15), PointF(13, 2),
 PointF(13, 16), PointF(13, 17), PointF(15, 16), PointF(16, 16)},
 {PointF(11, 16), PointF(12, 14), PointF(14, 4), PointF(14, 15),
 PointF(15, 3), PointF(15, 9), PointF(15, 15), PointF(16, 15)} };
 for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(pieces_vector[k]) / sizeof(pieces_vector[k][0]); i++) {
 int x = static_cast<int>(pieces_vector[k][i].x);
 int y = static_cast<int>(pieces_vector[k][i].y);
 AddPieces(page, k % 2 ? white_pieces : black_pieces,
 RectF(start_x + x * width - width / 2.f, start_y + y * width - width / 2.f,
 start_x + x * width + width / 2.f, start_y + y * width + width / 2.f));
 }
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc(L"graphics_objects.pdf");
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load();
 // Add a new PDF page and insert path objects, and copy shading objects.
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(2);
 PDFPage original_page = doc.GetPage(0);
 original_page.StartParse(PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 POSITION position = original_page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypeShading);
 ShadingObject* black_pieces = (ShadingObject*)original_page.GetGraphicsObject(position);
 ShadingObject* white_pieces = (ShadingObject*)original_page.GetGraphicsObject(position);
 AddPathObjects(page, black_pieces, white_pieces);

 Library::Release();
}

---

how to create a text object in a pdf page
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace graphics;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void AddTextObjects(PDFPage page) {
 POSITION position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypeText);
 TextObject* text_object = TextObject::Create();

 text_object->SetFillColor(0xFFFF7F00);

 // Prepare text state
 TextState state;
 state.font_size = 80.0f;
 state.font = Font(L"Simsun", Font::e_StylesSmallCap, Font::e_CharsetGB2312, 0);
 state.textmode = TextState::e_ModeFill;
 text_object->SetTextState(page, state, false, 750);

 // Set text.
 text_object->SetText(L"Foxit Software");
 POSITION last_position = page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, text_object);

 RectF rect = text_object->GetRect();
 float offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.8f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 text_object->Transform(Matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 // Generate content
 page.GenerateContent();

 // Clone a text object from the old text object.
 text_object = reinterpret_cast<TextObject*>(text_object->Clone());

 state.font = Font(Font::e_StdIDTimes);
 state.font_size = 48;
 state.textmode = TextState::e_ModeFillStrokeClip;

 text_object->SetTextState(page, state, true, 750);
 text_object->SetText(L"www.foxitsoftware.com");

 text_object->SetFillColor(0xFFAAAAAA);
 text_object->SetStrokeColor(0xFFF68C21);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(last_position, text_object);

 rect = text_object->GetRect();
 offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.618f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 text_object->Transform(Matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 // Generate content again after transformation.
 page.GenerateContent();

 //Show how to get the characters' information of text object.
 int text_object_charcount = text_object->GetCharCount();

 for (int i = 0; i < text_object_charcount; i++) {
 //The character's position.
 PointF char_pos = text_object->GetCharPos(i);
 //The character's width.
 float width = text_object->GetCharWidthByIndex(i);
 //The character's height.
 float height = text_object->GetCharHeightByIndex(i);
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc(L"graphics_objects.pdf");
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load();
 // Add a new PDF page and insert text objects.
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0);
 AddTextObjects(page);

 Library::Release();
}

How to get associate files in annotation dictionary ?
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfassociatefiles.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::objects;
using namespace pdf::annots;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 PDFDoc doc("Simple.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 AssociatedFiles associated_files(doc);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 Annot annot = page.GetAnnot(0);
 PDFDictionary* annot_dict = annot.GetDict();
 associated_files.GetAssociatedFilesCount(annot_dict);
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(annot_dict, 0);
 filespec.ExportToFile(L"af_4.txt");
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

how to import a fdf file
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;

static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Import FDF file
 WString input_file = L"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 WString fdf_file = L"AnnotationData.fdf";
 pdf::PDFDoc pdf_doc(input_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = pdf_doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 printf("The Doc [%s] Error: %d\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(input_file), error_code);
 return 1;
 }

 fdf::FDFDoc fdf_doc(fdf_file);
 pdf_doc.ImportFromFDF(fdf_doc, PDFDoc::e_Annots);

 Library::Release();

how to combine pdf files
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_combination.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 cout << "===Start combine pdf files===" << endl;
 foxit::pdf::CombineDocumentInfo file_info1(L"Annot_all.pdf", L"");
 file_info1.SetBookmarkTitle(L"Annot_all.pdf");
 file_info1.SetPDFFileName(L"Annot_all.pdf");

 foxit::pdf::PDFDoc pdfdoc(L"PDF2Img.pdf");
 if (foxit::e_ErrSuccess != pdfdoc.Load("")) return 1;
 foxit::pdf::CombineDocumentInfo file_info2(pdfdoc);
 file_info2.SetBookmarkTitle(L"PDF2Img.pdf");
 file_info2.SetPDFFileName(L"PDF2Img.pdf");

 foxit::pdf::CombineDocumentInfo file_info3(L"SamplePDF.pdf", L"");
 file_info3.SetBookmarkTitle(L"SamplePDF.pdf");
 file_info3.SetPDFFileName(L"SamplePDF.pdf");

 CombineDocumentInfoArray combine_document_array;
 combine_document_array.Add(file_info1);
 combine_document_array.Add(file_info2);
 combine_document_array.Add(file_info3);

 Combination::StartCombineDocuments(L"pdfcombination.pdf", combine_document_array, 0xFFFFFFFC);
 cout << "===PDF combination end===" << endl;

 Library::Release();
 }
}

how to optimize PDF files by compressing images
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/optimization/fs_optimization.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::addon;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 PDFDoc doc(L"ImageCompression.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 addon::optimization::OptimizerSettings settings;
 settings.SetOptimizerOptions(foxit::addon::optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_OptimizerCompressImages);
 common::Progressive progressive = addon::optimization::Optimizer::Optimize(doc, settings, NULL);
 Progressive::State progress_state = Progressive::e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive::e_ToBeContinued == progress_state) {
 progress_state = progressive.Continue();
 int percent = progressive.GetRateOfProgress();
 String res_string;
 res_string.Format("Optimize progress percent: %d %", percent);
 std::cout << res_string << std::endl;
 }
 if (Progressive::e_Finished == progress_state)
 {
 doc.SaveAs(L"ImageCompression_Optimized.pdf", foxit::pdf::PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects);
 }

 Library::Release();
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to Get the annotation at a specified position in device coordinate system.
```C+
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess)return 1;

 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"input_file.pdf");
 doc.Load();
 PDFPage pPage = doc.GetPage(0);
 Matrix matrix =
 pPDFPage.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, pPDFPage.GetWidth(), pPDFPage.GetHeight(), foxit::common::e_Rotation0);
 PointF point(5.0, 5.0);
 Annot annot = pPage.GetAnnotAtPoint(pointF, 0.0f, &matrix);
 Library::Release();
}
```

how to get marked content
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/objects/fs_pdfobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace graphics;
using namespace objects;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

bool GetMarkedContentObject(WString pdf_file) {
 PDFDoc doc(pdf_file);
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load();
 if (ret != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 printf("[Failed] Cannot load PDF document %s.\r\n Error message:%d\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(pdf_file), ret);
 return false;
 }
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 POSITION position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypeText);
 TextObject* text_obj = reinterpret_cast<TextObject*>(page.GetGraphicsObject(position));
 MarkedContent* content = text_obj->GetMarkedContent();
 int item_count = content->GetItemCount();

 WString file_info = L"markedcontent.txt";
 // Get marked content property
 for (int i = 0; i < item_count; i++) {
 printf("index: %d\r\n", i);
 String tag_name = content->GetItemTagName(i);
 printf("Tag name: %s\r\n", (const char*)tag_name);
 int mcid = content->GetItemMCID(i);
 printf("mcid: %d\r\n", mcid);
 }
 return true;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 GetMarkedContentObject(L"marked_content.pdf");

 Library::Release();
}

how to check the information of existed signature

#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_signature.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace objects;
using namespace file;

#include "../../../include/openssl/rsa.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/evp.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/objects.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/x509.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/err.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pem.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/ssl.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs12.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/rand.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs7.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/stack.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/ts.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs7.h"

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void CheckSignatureInfo(PDFDoc pdf_doc) {
 int sig_count = pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount();
 if (sig_count < 1) {
 return;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < sig_count; i++) {
 Signature signature = pdf_doc.GetSignature(i);
 if (signature.IsEmpty()) continue;
 bool is_signed = signature.IsSigned();
 uint32 sig_state = signature.GetState();

 annots::Widget widget_annot = signature.GetControl(0).GetWidget();

 String filter = signature.GetFilter();
 String sub_filter = signature.GetSubFilter();
 if (is_signed) {
 DateTime sign_time = signature.GetSignTime();
 }
 WString key_value;
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameSigner);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameLocation);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameReason);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameContactInfo);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameDN);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameText);
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
 PDFDoc pdf_doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(NULL, false, NULL);

 // Check information of existed signature(s) in PDF file if there's any signature in the PDF file.
 CheckSignatureInfo(pdf_doc);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to summary annotation
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_annotationsummary.h"

using namespace std;

 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");

 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of replace type
#include <time.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_search.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/comparison/fs_compare.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fxcrt/fx_basic.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace common;
using namespace addon;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::pdf::annots;
using namespace foxit::addon::comparison;

void CreateSquigglyRect(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, RGB color, WString ws_contents, WString ws_type, WString ws_obj_type) {
 annots::Squiggly squiggly(page.AddAnnot(Annot::e_Squiggly, RectF()));
 squiggly.SetContent(ws_contents);

 annots::QuadPointsArray quad_points_array;
 int rect_size = rects.GetSize();
 for (int i = 0; i < rect_size; i++) {
 CFX_FloatRect item = rects.GetAt(i);
 annots::QuadPoints quad_points;
 quad_points.first = PointF(item.left, item.top);
 quad_points.second = PointF(item.right, item.top);
 quad_points.third = PointF(item.left, item.bottom);
 quad_points.fourth = PointF(item.right, item.bottom);
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 }
 squiggly.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);

 squiggly.SetBorderColor(color);
 squiggly.SetSubject(ws_obj_type);
 squiggly.SetTitle(ws_type);

 squiggly.ResetAppearanceStream();
}
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc base_doc(L"test_base.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = base_doc.Load();
 PDFDoc compared_doc(L"test_compared.pdf");
 error_code = compared_doc.Load();
 Comparison comparison(base_doc, compared_doc);

 // Start comparing.
 CompareResults result = comparison.DoCompare(0, 0, Comparison::e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray& old_info = result.base_doc_results;
 CompareResultInfoArray& new_info = result.compared_doc_results;
 int old_info_size = old_info.GetSize();
 PDFPage page_base = base_doc.GetPage(0);
 for (int i = 0; i < old_info_size; i++) {
 const CompareResultInfo& item = old_info.GetAt(i);
 CompareResultInfo::CompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == CompareResultInfo::e_CompareResultTypeDeleteText) {
 String res_string;
 res_string.Format("[New]: \"%s\"\r\n[Old]: \"%s\"", (FX_LPCSTR)String::FromUnicode(new_info.GetAt(i).diff_contents), (FX_LPCSTR)String::FromUnicode(item.diff_contents));
 CreateSquigglyRect(page_base, item.rect_array, 0xe7651a, WString::FromLocal(res_string), L"Compare : Replace", L"Text");
 }
 }
 base_doc.SaveAs(L"Replace_result.pdf");

 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to convert pdf page to image file
#include <iostream>
#include <time.h>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"

#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void Save2Image(Bitmap& bitmap, int page_index, const char* sExt, bool from_memory) {
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 WString s;
 if (from_memory)
 s.Format((FX_LPCWSTR)L"AboutFoxit_from_memory_%d", page_index);
 else
 s.Format((FX_LPCWSTR)L"AboutFoxit_%d", page_index);
 s = s + WString::FromLocal(sExt);
 image.SaveAs(s);
}

void PDF2Image(PDFDoc doc, bool from_memory) {
 const char* support_image_extends[] = { ".bmp", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".jpx", ".jp2" };

 // Get page count
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 int width = static_cast<int>(page.GetWidth());
 int height = static_cast<int>(page.GetHeight());
 Matrix matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, width, height, page.GetRotation());

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 Bitmap bitmap(width, height, foxit::common::Bitmap::e_DIBArgb, NULL, 0);
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, NULL);

 // Render page
 Renderer render(bitmap, false);
 render.StartRender(page, matrix, NULL);
 for (unsigned int j = 0; j < sizeof(support_image_extends) / sizeof(support_image_extends[0]); j++) {
 const char* extend = support_image_extends[j];
 Save2Image(bitmap, i, extend, from_memory);
 }
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 PDF2Image(doc, false);
 }

 Library::Release();
}

how to export XFDF file
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using foxit::common::Library;

using namespace annots;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
//initialize foxit pdf sdk
foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
}

{
 // Export XFDF file

 WString output_xfdf = L"AnnotationDataExport_xfdf.xfdf";

 pdf::PDFDoc pdf_doc(input_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = pdf_doc.Load();

How to associate file to FormX object?
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfassociatefiles.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::objects;
using namespace pdf::annots;
using namespace pdf::graphics;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 PDFDoc doc("Simple.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 AssociatedFiles associated_files(doc);

 //Create filespec with 2.jpg
 FileSpec filespec_jpg(doc);
 filespec_jpg.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles::e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.SetFileName(L"2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.SetDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.Embed(L"2.jpg");
 DateTime dateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0);
 filespec_jpg.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetSubtype();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);;
 page.StartParse();
 POSITION position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject::e_TypeFormXObject);
 FormXObject* form_x_object = (FormXObject*)page.GetGraphicsObject(position);
 if (form_x_object) {
 associated_files.AssociateFile(form_x_object, filespec_jpg);
 }

 WString newPdf = L"newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

how to verify pdfa 1a version

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_compliancecommon.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfa.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfcompliance.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace addon;
using namespace compliance;

// user enters the sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 {
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine::Initialize(L" ", "");
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 switch (error_code) {
 case foxit::e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 printf("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.\n");
 break;
 default:
 printf("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: %d\n", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return 1;
 }

 // Set custom temp folder path for ComplianceEngine.
 //ComplianceEngine::SetTempFolderPath(L"");
 // Set languages. If not set language to ComplianceEngine, "English" will be used as default.
 //ComplianceEngine::SetLanguage("Chinese-Simplified");

 PDFACompliance pdfa_compliance;
 {
 // Verify original PDF file.
 ResultInformation verify_result_info = pdfa_compliance.Verify(PDFACompliance::e_VersionPDFA1a, L"AboutFoxit.pdf", 0, -1, NULL);
 //this is a compliance pdf verify before convert hitdata
 }

 // Release compliance engine.
 ComplianceEngine::Release();
 }
 Library::Release();
}
