---

how to do some operation about PDF object
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/objects/fs_pdfobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace objects;

void ObjectOperation(PDFDoc document) {
 PDFObject* boolean_object = PDFObject::CreateFromBoolean(true);
 uint32 boolean_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(boolean_object);

 bool boolean_object_value = boolean_object->GetBoolean();
 PDFObject* float_object = PDFObject::CreateFromFloat(0.1f);
 uint32 float_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(float_object);
 float float_object_value = float_object->GetFloat();

 PDFObject* integer_object = PDFObject::CreateFromInteger(1);
 uint32 integer_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(integer_object);
 int integer_object_value = integer_object->GetInteger();

 PDFObject* string_object = PDFObject::CreateFromString(L"foxit");
 uint32 string_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(string_object);
 WString string_object_value = string_object->GetWideString();

 PDFObject* name_object = PDFObject::CreateFromName("sdk");
 uint32 name_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(name_object);
 String name_object_value = name_object->GetName();

 DateTime date_time(2017, 9, 27, 19, 36, 6, 0, 8, 0);
 PDFObject* datetime_object = PDFObject::CreateFromDateTime(date_time);
 uint32 datetime_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(datetime_object);
 WString datetime_object_value = datetime_object->GetWideString();

 PDFArray* array = PDFArray::Create();
 PDFObject* boolean_object_reference = PDFObject::CreateReference(document, boolean_object_number);
 uint32 boolean_object_reference_number = boolean_object_reference->GetObjNum();
 PDFObject* float_object_reference = PDFObject::CreateReference(document, float_object_number);
 PDFObject* integer_object_reference = PDFObject::CreateReference(document, integer_object_number);
 PDFObject* integer_object_direct = integer_object_reference->GetDirectObject();
 PDFObject* string_object_reference = PDFObject::CreateReference(document, string_object_number);
 PDFObject* name_object_reference = PDFObject::CreateReference(document, name_object_number);
 PDFObject* datetime_object_reference = PDFObject::CreateReference(document, datetime_object_number);

 array->AddElement(boolean_object_reference);
 array->AddElement(float_object_reference);
 array->AddElement(integer_object_reference);
 array->AddElement(string_object_reference);
 array->AddElement(name_object_reference);
 array->AddElement(datetime_object_reference);
 array->AddElement(boolean_object->CloneObject());

 uint32 array_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(array);
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"pdfobjects.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 doc.StartLoad(NULL, false, NULL);

 // Do some operation about PDF object.
 ObjectOperation(doc);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

how to add and sign a PAdES signature
#include <iostream>
#include <time.h>
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_signature.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace objects;
using namespace file;

#define ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_FILTER "Adobe.PPKLite"
#define ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER "ETSI.CAdES.detached"
//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void PAdESSign(const WString& input_pdf_path, const WString& signed_pdf_path, Signature::PAdESLevel pades_level) {
 WString cached_signed_pdf_path = signed_pdf_path;
 WString real_signed_pdf_path = signed_pdf_path;
 if (pades_level > Signature::e_PAdESLevelBT) {
 cached_signed_pdf_path = signed_pdf_path.Left(signed_pdf_path.GetLength() - 4) + L"_cache.pdf";
 }

 PDFDoc pdf_doc(input_pdf_path);
 interform::Form form(pdf_doc);
 pdf_doc.StartLoad();
 PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0);
 float page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight();
 RectF new_sig_rect((page_width / 2 - 50.0f), (page_height / 2 - 50.0f), (page_width / 2 + 50.0f), (page_height / 2 + 50.0f));
 Signature new_signature = pdf_page.AddSignature(new_sig_rect);
 new_signature.SetFilter(ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_FILTER);
 new_signature.SetSubFilter(ETSICADES_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER);

 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameSigner, L"Foxit PDF SDK");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameContactInfo, L"support@foxitsoftware.com");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameDN, L"CN=CN,MAIL=MAIL@MAIL.COM");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameLocation, L"Fuzhou, China");

 // Set appearance flags to decide which content would be used in appearance.
 uint32 ap_flags = Signature::e_APFlagLabel | Signature::e_APFlagSigner |
 Signature::e_APFlagReason | Signature::e_APFlagDN |
 Signature::e_APFlagLocation | Signature::e_APFlagText |
 Signature::e_APFlagSigningTime;
 new_signature.SetAppearanceFlags(ap_flags);

 WString cert_path = L"foxit_all.pfx";
 WString cert_password = L"123456";
 Progressive sign_progressive = new_signature.StartSign(cert_path, cert_password, Signature::e_DigestSHA256, cached_signed_pdf_path);
 if (sign_progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100) {
 if (Progressive::e_Finished != sign_progressive.Continue()) {
 return;
 }
 }

 if (pades_level > Signature::e_PAdESLevelBT) {
 PDFDoc cache_pdf_doc(cached_signed_pdf_path);
 cache_pdf_doc.StartLoad();
 // Here, we only simply create an empty DSS object in PDF document, just as a simple exmaple.
 // In fact, user should use LTVVerifier to add DSS.
 cache_pdf_doc.CreateDSS();

 if (pades_level > Signature::e_PAdESLevelBLT) {
 PDFPage cache_pdf_page = cache_pdf_doc.GetPage(0);
 Signature time_stamp_signature = cache_pdf_page.AddSignature(RectF(), L"", Signature::e_SignatureTypeTimeStamp);
 Progressive sign_ts_progressive = time_stamp_signature.StartSign(L"", L"", Signature::e_DigestSHA256, real_signed_pdf_path);
 if (sign_ts_progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100) {
 if (Progressive::e_Finished != sign_ts_progressive.Continue()) {
 return;
 }
 }
 }
 else {
 cache_pdf_doc.SaveAs(real_signed_pdf_path, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagIncremental);
 }
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 TimeStampServerMgr::Initialize();
 Signature::PAdESLevel level = Signature::e_PAdESLevelBB;
 PAdESSign(L"AboutFoxit.pdf", L"AboutFoxit.pdf", level);

 TimeStampServerMgr::Release();
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to clone bitmap with the bounding box according to the given background color?

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, WString file_path) {
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(file_path);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 Image image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 // Calculate the bounding box according to the given background color.
 RectI rect = bitmap.CalculateBBoxByColor(0xFFFDFDFD);
 Bitmap clone_bitmap;
 if (rect.Height() > 0 && rect.Width() > 0) {
 clone_bitmap = bitmap.Clone(&rect);
 WString output_file = L"calculate_bbox_by_color_0xFFFDFDFD_foxit.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(clone_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to recognize form in pdf
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/interform/fs_pdfform.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;
using namespace interform;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 doc.Load();
 interform::Form form(doc);
 int count = form.GetFieldCount();
 //Start to recognize form in current PDF document.
 doc.StartRecognizeForm(NULL);
 count = form.GetFieldCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 Field field = form.GetField(i);
 WString str;
 str.Format(L"NO.%d", i + 1);
 field.SetValue(str);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to swap bitmap?

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, WString file_path) {
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(file_path);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 Image image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 // Swap the X and Y axis, and then vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 Bitmap swap_xy_bitmap = bitmap.SwapXY(true, true, NULL);
 WString output_file = L"swap_xy_flip_horz_vert_Foxit.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(swap_xy_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to add page label
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpagelabel.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load();
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Add new page labels
 PageLabels page_labels(doc);
 page_labels.RemoveAll();
 WString pdf_removeall = L"removeall_page_labels.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(pdf_removeall, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

 int count = doc.GetPageCount();
 if (count > 0) {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(0, PageLabels::e_UpperRomanNums, 1, L"Cover-");
 }
 if (count > 1) {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(1, PageLabels::e_LowerRomanNums, 1, L"Catolog-");
 }
 if (count > 2) {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(2, PageLabels::e_DecimalNums, 1, L"Contents-");
 }
 if (count > 5) {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(count - 1, PageLabels::e_UpperLetters, 1, L"Appendix-");
 }

 WString pdf_new = L"new_page_labels.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(pdf_new, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library::Release();
}

how to convert original PDF file to PDF - 1.7

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_compliancecommon.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfa.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfcompliance.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace addon;
using namespace compliance;

// user enters the sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine::Initialize(L" ", "");
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 switch (error_code) {
 case foxit::e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 printf("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.\n");
 break;
 default:
 printf("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: %d\n", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return 1;
 }
 cout << "ComplianceEngine is initialized." << endl;

 // Convert original PDF file to PDF-1.7.
 WString save_pdf_path = L"5_pdfcompliance_convert_to_1_7.pdf";
 PDFCompliance pdf_compliance;
 ResultInformation convert_result_info = pdf_compliance.ConvertPDFFile(L"AboutFoxit.pdf", save_pdf_path, 17, NULL);
 }

 // Release compliance engine.
 ComplianceEngine::Release();
 Library::Release();
}

---

Initialize Library It is necessary for applications to initialize Foxit PDF SDK before calling any APIs. The function foxit::common::Library::Initialize is provided to initialize Foxit PDF SDK. A license should be purchased for the application and pass unlock key and code to get proper supports. When there is no need to use Foxit PDF SDK any more, please call function foxit::common::Library::Release to release it. Note The parameter "sn" can be found in the "gsdk_sn.txt" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "gsdk_key.txt" (the string after "Sign=").
Example: 3.1.1 How to initialize Foxit PDF SDK
#include "include/common/fs_common.h"

using namespace foxit; using namespace common;
...
const char* sn = " ";
const char* key = " ";
foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) { return FALSE; }

how to encrypt a PDF file with Foxit DRM
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_security.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

bool FoxitDRMDecrypt(WString input_file) {
 PDFDoc doc(input_file);
 // Do encryption.
 DRMSecurityHandler handler = DRMSecurityHandler();
 const char* file_id = "Simple-DRM-file-ID";
 String initialize_key = "Simple-DRM-initialize-key";
 DRMEncryptData encrypt_data(true, "Simple-DRM-filter", SecurityHandler::e_CipherAES, 16, true, 0xfffffffc);
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, file_id, initialize_key);
 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler);

 WString output_file = L"foxit_drm_encrypt.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

 // Do decryption.
 PDFDoc encrypted_doc(output_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = encrypted_doc.Load(NULL);
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity();
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(L"foxit_drm_decrypt.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

 Library::UnregisterSecurityCallback("FoxitDRM");
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 FoxitDRMDecrypt(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to get all annotations in all pages?
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace common;
using namespace pdf;

const char* sn = "";
const char* key = "";

void main() {
	Library::Initialize(sn, key);

	{
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load("123");
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 cout << "Load document error!" << endl;
 }
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 int annot_count = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < annot_count; j++) {
 pdf::annots::Annot annot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 }
 }
	}

	Library::Release();
}

 return 1;

How to associate file to page dictionary?
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfassociatefiles.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::objects;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 PDFDoc doc("Simple.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 AssociatedFiles associated_files(doc);

 //Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt(doc);
 filespec_txt.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles::e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.SetFileName(L"1.txt");
 DateTime dateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0);
 filespec_txt.SetDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.Embed(L"1.txt");
 filespec_txt.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetSubtype();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse();

 associated_files.AssociateFile(page, filespec_txt);

 WString newPdf = L"newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

how to open a document including wrapper data
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_render.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace common::file;

bool OpenWrapperFile(WString file_name) {

 PDFDoc doc(file_name);
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load();

 int64 offset = doc.GetWrapperOffset();
 WrapperData wrapper_data = doc.GetWrapperData();

 return true;
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc_wrapper(L"wrapper.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc_wrapper.Load();
 // Save the PDF document as a wrapper file.
 WrapperData wrapperData(10, L"Foxit", L"Foxit", L"www.foxitsoftware.com", L"foxit");

 // "0xFFFFFFFC" can be changed to other values defined in enumeration FSUserPermissions.
 doc_wrapper.SaveAsWrapperFile(L"AboutFoxit_wrapper.pdf", &wrapperData, 0xFFFFFFFC);
 // Open the wrapper file.
 if (!OpenWrapperFile(L"AboutFoxit_wrapper.pdf")) {
 return 1;
 }

 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to add a single watermark
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_watermark.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void AddSingleWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page) {
 WatermarkSettings settings;
 settings.flags = WatermarkSettings::e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings::e_FlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0.f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.f;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = common::e_PosBottomRight;
 settings.rotation = 0.0f;
 settings.scale_x = 0.1f;
 settings.scale_y = 0.1f;

 Watermark watermark(doc, page, settings);
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();

 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 page.StartParse(PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 AddSingleWatermark(doc, page);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to add a circle annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here

static const char* key = "";

{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 // Add circle annotation
 annots::Circle circle(page.AddAnnot(annots::Annot::e_Circle,RectF(100,650,200,750)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 circle.SetFlags(4);
 circle.SetInnerRect(RectF(120,660,160,740));
 circle.SetSubject(L"Circle");
 circle.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 circle.SetCreationDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 circle.SetModifiedDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());

 circle.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a circle annotation." << endl;

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get annotation rectangle in device coordinate system.

```c++
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess)return 1;

 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"input_file.pdf");
 doc.Load();
 PDFPage pPage = doc.GetPage(0);
 float fPageWidth = pPage.GetWidth();
 float fPageHeight = pPage.GetHeight();
 float bmpWidth[2] = { fPageWidth,2 * fPageWidth };
 float bmpheight[2] = { fPageHeight,2 * fPageHeight };

 for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
 Matrix setMatrix = pPage.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, bmpWidth[i], bmpheight[i], e_Rotation0);
 int iAnnotCount = pPage.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++) {
 Annot pAnnot = pPage.GetAnnot(j);
 RectI deviceRect = pAnnot.GetDeviceRect(setMatrix);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}
```

how to add a text form field to a PDF
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/interform/fs_pdfform.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace annots;
using namespace actions;
using namespace interform;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 PDFDoc doc;
 interform::Form form(doc);
 // Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0);
 {
 // Add text field
 Control control = form.AddControl(page, L"Text Field0", Field::e_TypeTextField, RectF(50, 600, 90, 640));
 control.GetField().SetValue(L"3");
 // Update text field's appearance.
 control.GetWidget().ResetAppearanceStream();

 Control control1 = form.AddControl(page, L"Text Field1", Field::e_TypeTextField, RectF(100, 600, 140, 640));
 control1.GetField().SetValue(L"23");
 // Update text field's appearance.
 control1.GetWidget().ResetAppearanceStream();

 Control control2 = form.AddControl(page, L"Text Field2", Field::e_TypeTextField, RectF(150, 600, 190, 640));
 actions::JavaScriptAction javascipt_action = (actions::JavaScriptAction)Action::Create(form.GetDocument(), Action::e_TypeJavaScript);
 javascipt_action.SetScript(L"AFSimple_Calculate(\"SUM\", new Array (\"Text Field0\", \"Text Field1\"));");
 Field field2 = control2.GetField();
 AdditionalAction additional_act(field2);
 additional_act.SetAction(AdditionalAction::e_TriggerFieldRecalculateValue, javascipt_action);
 field2.SetValue(L"333333");
 // Update text field's appearance.
 control2.GetWidget().ResetAppearanceStream();
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to get associate files in catalog dictionary ?
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"

static const char* key = "";

{
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {

 doc.Load();

 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(doc_catalog_dict, 0);
 filespec.ExportToFile(L"af_1.txt");
 }
 Library::Release();

how to remove properties from catalog dictionary

#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/objects/fs_pdfobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace objects;

// This function is to remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
void RemoveCatalogKey(PDFDoc document) {
 if (document.IsEmpty()) return;

 PDFDictionary* catalog = document.GetCatalog();
 if (NULL == catalog) return;

 const char* key_strings[] = { "Type", "Boolean", "Name", "String", "Array", "Dict" };
 int count = sizeof(key_strings) / sizeof(key_strings[0]);
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 if (catalog->HasKey(key_strings[i]))
 catalog->RemoveAt(key_strings[i]);
 }
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 // To remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 RemoveCatalogKey(doc);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

How to load a PDF document from memory?

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <io.h>
#include "include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using namespace foxit::pdf;

int main()
{
 // Declare the sn and key for the Foxit SDK. These values must be filled in correctly.
 static const char* sn = "";
 static const char* key = "";

 // Initialize the Foxit SDK.
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess)
 return 1;

 {
 // Load the PDF file into memory.
 FILE* file = fopen("sample.pdf", "rb");
 fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END);
 long long_file_size = ftell(file);
 char* buffer = new char[long_file_size];
 memset(buffer, 0, sizeof(char)*long_file_size);
 fseek(file, 0, SEEK_SET);
 fread(buffer, sizeof(char), long_file_size, file);
 fclose(file);

 // Create a PDFDoc object using the buffer and its size.
 PDFDoc doc(buffer, long_file_size);

 // Load the PDF document from memory.
 doc.Load();

 // Use the PDF document as needed.

 // Free the buffer.
 delete[] buffer;
 }

 // Release the Foxit SDK.
 Library::Release();

 return 0;
}
```

Here's a breakdown of the steps:
1. Declare sn and key. Make sure to fill in the correct values for these variables.
2. Initialize the library using `Library::Initialize()`.
3. Load the PDF file into memory with file buffer.
4. Create a `PDFDoc` object using the buffer and its size.
5. Load the PDF document from memory using `doc.Load()`.
6. Perform any necessary operations on the PDF document.
7. Free the buffer by deleting the allocated memory.
8. Release the Foxit SDK using `Library::Release()`. note: Please ensure that all SDK objects have been released before the Library is released.

how to remove all watermark
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_watermark.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 page.StartParse(PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 if (page.HasWatermark()) {
 page.RemoveAllWatermarks();
 }
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to add a line annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 // Add line annotation
 // No special intent, as a common line.
 annots::Line line(page.AddAnnot(annots::Annot::e_Line,RectF(0,650,100,750)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 line.SetFlags(4);
 line.SetStartPoint(PointF(20,650));
 line.SetEndPoint(PointF(100,740));
 // Intent, as line arrow.
 line.SetContent(L"A line arrow annotation");
 line.SetIntent("LineArrow");
 line.SetSubject(L"Arrow");
 line.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 line.SetCreationDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 line.SetModifiedDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 // Appearance must be reset.
 line.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a line annotations." << endl;

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

---

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of delete type
#include <time.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_search.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/comparison/fs_compare.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fxcrt/fx_basic.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace common;
using namespace addon;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::pdf::annots;
using namespace foxit::addon::comparison;

void CreateDeleteText(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, RGB color, WString ws_contents, WString ws_type, WString ws_obj_type) {
 annots::StrikeOut strikeout(page.AddAnnot(Annot::e_StrikeOut, RectF()));
 strikeout.SetContent(ws_contents);

 annots::QuadPointsArray quad_points_array;
 int rect_size = rects.GetSize();
 for (int i = 0; i < rect_size; i++) {
 CFX_FloatRect item = rects.GetAt(i);
 annots::QuadPoints quad_points;
 quad_points.first = PointF(item.left, item.top);
 quad_points.second = PointF(item.right, item.top);
 quad_points.third = PointF(item.left, item.bottom);
 quad_points.fourth = PointF(item.right, item.bottom);
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 }
 strikeout.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);

 strikeout.SetBorderColor(color);
 strikeout.SetSubject(ws_obj_type);
 strikeout.SetTitle(ws_type);

 strikeout.ResetAppearanceStream();
}
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc base_doc(L"test_base.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = base_doc.Load();
 PDFDoc compared_doc(L"test_compared.pdf");
 error_code = compared_doc.Load();
 Comparison comparison(base_doc, compared_doc);

 // Start comparing.
 CompareResults result = comparison.DoCompare(0, 0, Comparison::e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray& old_info = result.base_doc_results;
 CompareResultInfoArray& new_info = result.compared_doc_results;
 int old_info_size = old_info.GetSize();
 PDFPage page_base = base_doc.GetPage(0);
 for (int i = 0; i < old_info_size; i++) {
 const CompareResultInfo& item = old_info.GetAt(i);
 CompareResultInfo::CompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == CompareResultInfo::e_CompareResultTypeDeleteText) {
 String res_string;
 res_string.Format((FX_LPCSTR)"\"%s\"", (FX_LPCSTR)String::FromUnicode(item.diff_contents));
 // Add stamp to mark the "delete" type differences between the two documents
 CreateDeleteText(page_base, item.rect_array, 0xff0000, WString::FromLocal(res_string), L"Compare : Delete", L"Text");
 }
 }
 base_doc.SaveAs(L"result.pdf");

 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

how to encrypt a PDF file with Certificate
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_security.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

bool CertificateSecurity(WString input_file) {
 PDFDoc doc(input_file);
 // Do encryption.
 StringArray envelopes;
 String initial_key;
 WString cert_file_path = L"foxit.cer";

 CertificateSecurityHandler handler;
 CertificateEncryptData encrypt_data(true, SecurityHandler::e_CipherAES, envelopes);
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, initial_key);

 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler);
 WString output_file = L"certificate_encrypt.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

 PDFDoc encrypted_doc(output_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = encrypted_doc.Load(NULL);
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 printf("The Doc [%s] Error: %d\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(output_file), error_code);
 return false;
 }

 output_file = L"certificate_decrypt.pdf";
 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity();
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

}
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 CertificateSecurity(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

how to optimize pdf file by discard useless uer data
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/optimization/fs_optimization.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace foxit::addon;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 PDFDoc doc(L"DiscardObjects.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 addon::optimization::OptimizerSettings settings;
 settings.SetOptimizerOptions(foxit::addon::optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_OptimizerDiscardObjects);
 settings.SetDiscardObjectsOptions(optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_DiscardObjectsBookmarks | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_DiscardObjectsEmbeddedPageThumbnails
 | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_DiscardObjectsEmbeddedPrintSettings | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_DiscardObjectsFlattenFormFields
 | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_DiscardObjectsFormActions | optimization::OptimizerSettings::e_DiscardObjectsJavaScriptActions);

 common::Progressive progressive = addon::optimization::Optimizer::Optimize(doc, settings, NULL);
 Progressive::State progress_state = Progressive::e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive::e_ToBeContinued == progress_state) {
 progress_state = progressive.Continue();
 int percent = progressive.GetRateOfProgress();
 String res_string;
 res_string.Format("Optimize progress percent: %d %", percent);
 std::cout << res_string << std::endl;
 }
 if (Progressive::e_Finished == progress_state) {
 doc.SaveAs(L"DiscardObjects_Optimized.pdf", foxit::pdf::PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects);
 }

 Library::Release();
}

how to create a text watermark
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_watermark.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

void AddTextWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page) {
 WatermarkSettings settings;
 settings.flags = WatermarkSettings::e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings::e_FlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0;
 settings.offset_y = 0;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = common::e_PosTopRight;
 settings.rotation = -45.f;
 settings.scale_x = 1.f;
 settings.scale_y = 1.f;

 WatermarkTextProperties text_properties;
 text_properties.alignment = CommonDefines::e_AlignmentCenter;
 text_properties.color = 0xF68C21;
 text_properties.font_style = WatermarkTextProperties::e_FontStyleNormal;
 text_properties.line_space = 1;
 text_properties.font_size = 12.f;
 text_properties.font = Font(Font::e_StdIDTimesB);

 Watermark watermark(doc, L"Foxit PDF SDK\nwww.foxitsoftware.com", text_properties, settings);
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);

}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();

 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 page.StartParse(PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 AddTextWatermark(doc, page);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}

---

how to search text for PDF document
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_search.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

void OutputMatchedInfo(TextSearch search, int matched_index) {
 int page_index = search.GetMatchPageIndex();
 WString format_str = L"";
 printf("Index of matched pattern:\t%d\r\n", matched_index);
 printf("\tpage:\t%d\r\n", page_index);
 printf("\tmatch char start index:\t%d\r\n", search.GetMatchStartCharIndex());
 printf("\tmatch char end index:\t%d\r\n", search.GetMatchEndCharIndex());
 printf("\tmatch sentence start index:\t%d\r\n", search.GetMatchSentenceStartIndex());
 RectFArray rect_array = search.GetMatchRects();
 int rect_count = rect_array.GetSize();
 printf("\tmatch rectangles count:\t%d\r\n", rect_count);
 for (int i = 0; i < rect_count; i++) {
 foxit::RectF rect = rect_array[i];
 printf("\trectangle(in PDF space) :%d\t[left = %.4f, bottom = %.4f, right = %.4f, top = %.4f]\r\n", i,
 rect.left, rect.bottom, rect.right, rect.top);
 }
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 WString input_file = L"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 PDFDoc doc(input_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 // sample 1: search for all pages of doc.
 TextSearch search(doc, NULL);
 int start_index = 0, end_index = doc.GetPageCount() - 1;
 search.SetStartPage(0);
 search.SetEndPage(doc.GetPageCount() - 1);
 WString pattern = L"Foxit";
 search.SetPattern(pattern);
 foxit::uint32 flags = TextSearch::e_SearchNormal;
 search.SetSearchFlags(flags);
 WString format_str = L"";
 printf("Start index:\t%d\r\n", start_index);
 printf("End index:\t%d\r\n", end_index);
 WString match_case = flags & TextSearch::e_SearchMatchCase ? L"Yes" : L"No";
 WString match_whole_word = flags & TextSearch::e_SearchMatchWholeWord ? L"Yes" : L"No";
 WString match_consecutive = flags & TextSearch::e_SearchConsecutive ? L"Yes" : L"No";
 int match_count = 0;
 while (search.FindNext()) {
 RectFArray rect_array = search.GetMatchRects();
 OutputMatchedInfo(search, match_count);
 match_count++;
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to add a polyline annotation

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc("Sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 // Add polyline annotation
 annots::PolyLine polyline(page.AddAnnot(Annot::e_PolyLine,RectF(500,650,600,700)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 polyline.SetFlags(4);
 foxit::PointFArray vertexe_array;
 vertexe_array.Add(PointF(515,705));
 vertexe_array.Add(PointF(535,740));
 vertexe_array.Add(PointF(565,740));
 vertexe_array.Add(PointF(585,705));
 vertexe_array.Add(PointF(565,665));
 vertexe_array.Add(PointF(535,665));
 polyline.SetVertexes(vertexe_array);
 polyline.SetSubject(L"PolyLine");
 polyline.SetTitle(L"Foxit SDK");
 polyline.SetCreationDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());
 polyline.SetModifiedDateTime(DateTime::GetLocalTime());

 // Appearance must be reset.
 polyline.ResetAppearanceStream();
 cout << "Add a polyline annotation." << endl;

 // Save PDF file
 WString newPdf = L"newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to Convert PDF file to PDF - 1.4
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_compliancecommon.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfa.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/compliance/fs_pdfcompliance.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace addon;
using namespace compliance;

// user enters the sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine::Initialize(L" ", "");
 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 switch (error_code) {
 case foxit::e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 printf("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.\n");
 break;
 default:
 printf("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: %d\n", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return 1;
 }
 cout << "ComplianceEngine is initialized." << endl;

 PDFCompliance pdf_compliance;
 WString input_file = L"AF_ImageXObject_FormXObject.pdf";
 {
 // Convert original PDF file to PDF-1.4.
 WString save_pdf_path = L"4_pdfcompliance_convert_to_1_4.pdf";
 ResultInformation convert_result_info = pdf_compliance.ConvertPDFFile(input_file, save_pdf_path, 14, NULL);
 }

 // Release compliance engine.
 ComplianceEngine::Release();
 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to get associate files in page dictionary ?
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"

using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace pdf::objects;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 PDFDoc doc("Simple.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 AssociatedFiles associated_files(doc);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 PDFDictionary* page_dict = page.GetDict();
 associated_files.GetAssociatedFilesCount(page_dict);
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(page_dict, 0);
 filespec.ExportToFile(L"af_2.txt");
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

How to render pages or convert pdf to image.

#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"

#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 ErrorCode error_code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 doc.Load();
 const char* support_image_extends[] = {".bmp", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".jpx", ".jp2"};

 //Get page count
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for(int i=0;i<page_count;i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 int width = static_cast<int>(page.GetWidth());
 int height = static_cast<int>(page.GetHeight());
 Matrix matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, width, height, page.GetRotation());

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 Bitmap bitmap(width, height, foxit::common::Bitmap::e_DIBArgb, NULL, 0);
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, NULL);

 // Render page
 Renderer render(bitmap, false);
 render.StartRender(page, matrix, NULL);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

---

How to get bookmark information?

#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_bookmark.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

class TextDoc {
public:
 TextDoc(const String& file_name, const String& fill_mode);
 TextDoc(const WString& file_name, const WString& fill_mode);
 ~TextDoc();
 void Write(const char* format, ...);
 void Write(int count, const char* prefix, const char* format, ...);

private:
 FILE* file_;
};

TextDoc::TextDoc(const String& file_name, const String& file_mode) throw(Exception) : file_(NULL) {
#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
 fopen_s(&file_, (const char*)file_name, (const char*)file_mode);
#else
 file_ = fopen((const char*)file_name, (const char*)file_mode);
#endif

 if (!file_)
 throw Exception(__FILE__, __LINE__, __FUNCTION__, foxit::e_ErrFile);
}

TextDoc::TextDoc(const WString& file_name, const WString& file_mode) throw(Exception) : file_(NULL) {
 String s_file_name = String::FromUnicode(file_name);
 String s_file_mode = String::FromUnicode(file_mode);

#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
 fopen_s(&file_, (const char*)s_file_name, (const char*)s_file_mode);
#else
 file_ = fopen((const char*)s_file_name, (const char*)s_file_mode);
#endif
 if (!file_)
 throw Exception(__FILE__, __LINE__, __FUNCTION__, foxit::e_ErrFile);
}

TextDoc::~TextDoc() {
 fclose(file_);
 file_ = NULL;
}

void TextDoc::Write(const char* format, ...) {
 va_list vars;
 if (file_) {
 // Get variable list
 va_start(vars, format);
 // Call vfprintf to format log data and output to log file
 vfprintf(file_, format, vars);
 // End variable list
 va_end(vars);
 }
}

void TextDoc::Write(int count, const char * prefix, const char * format, ...) {
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 Write("%s", prefix);
 }
 va_list vars;
 if (file_) {
 // Get variable list
 va_start(vars, format);
 // Call vfprintf to format log data and output to log file
 vfprintf(file_, format, vars);
 // End variable list
 va_end(vars);
 }
}

void ShowBookmarkInfo(Bookmark bookmark, TextDoc& doc, int depth) {
 if (depth > 32)
 return;
 if (bookmark.IsEmpty())
 return;
 for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
 doc.Write("\t");
 }

 // Show bookmark's title.
 doc.Write("%s\t", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(bookmark.GetTitle()));

 // Show bookmark's color.
 doc.Write("color: %x\r\n", bookmark.GetColor());

 ShowBookmarkInfo(bookmark.GetFirstChild(), doc, depth + 1);
 ShowBookmarkInfo(bookmark.GetNextSibling(), doc, depth);
}

void ShowBookmarksInfo(PDFDoc doc, const WString& info_path) {
 TextDoc text_doc(info_path, L"w+b");
 Bookmark root = doc.GetRootBookmark();
 if (!root.IsEmpty()) {
 ShowBookmarkInfo(root, text_doc,0);
 } else {
 text_doc.Write("No bookmark information!\r\n");
 }
}
int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;

 Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 // Show original bookmark information.
 ShowBookmarksInfo(doc, L"bookmark_info.txt");
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

---

how to print a pdf file,how to print document?
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

#include "../../../include/common/fs_render.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 WString input_file = L"annotations.pdf";
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc(input_file);
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load();
 HDC hdc_print = NULL; // Printer DC handle
 char dev_string[120]; // An array for WIN.INI data
 char *printer = NULL, *driver = NULL; // Printer name and driver name
 char *port = NULL; // Port name
 char* context = NULL;

 // Retrieve the printer, printer driver, and output-port names from WIN.INI.
 GetProfileStringA("windows", "device", ",,,", dev_string, 120);

 // Parse the string of names, setting ptrs as required.
 // If the string contains the required names, use them to create a device context.
 if ((printer = strtok_s(dev_string, (const char *)",", &context)) && (driver = strtok_s((char *)NULL, (const char *)", ", &context)) &&
 (port = strtok_s((char *)NULL, (const char *)", ", &context))) {
 hdc_print = CreateDCA(driver, printer, port, NULL);
 }

 if (!hdc_print) {
 printf("[Failed] Cannot create HDC for print.\r\n");
 return 1;
 }

 char print_doc_name[128] = "";
 sprintf_s(print_doc_name, "FoxitPDFSDK_PrintingTest_%s", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(input_file));
 DOCINFOA doc_info;
 ZeroMemory(&doc_info, sizeof(DOCINFOA));
 doc_info.cbSize = sizeof(DOCINFOA);
 doc_info.lpszDocName = print_doc_name;
 doc_info.lpszOutput = NULL;
 doc_info.fwType = 0;
 // Begin a print job by calling the StartDoc function.
 int nError = StartDocA(hdc_print, &doc_info);
 if (nError == SP_ERROR) {
 MessageBoxA(NULL, "Error", "Error, Printing", MB_OK | MB_ICONEXCLAMATION);
 return 1;
 }
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse(PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 int width = static_cast<int>(page.GetWidth());
 int height = static_cast<int>(page.GetHeight());

 // Inform the driver that the application is about to begin sending data.
 nError = StartPage(hdc_print);
 if (nError == SP_ERROR) {
 MessageBoxA(NULL, "Error", "Error, Printing", MB_OK | MB_ICONEXCLAMATION);
 return 1;
 }

 float device_width = (float)GetDeviceCaps(hdc_print, HORZRES);
 float device_height = (float)GetDeviceCaps(hdc_print, VERTRES);
 float x_scale = device_width / width;
 float y_scale = device_height / height;

 float scale = x_scale < y_scale ? x_scale : y_scale;
 float x_offset = 0.0;
 float y_offset = 0.0;
 if (x_scale < y_scale) {
 y_offset = (device_height - scale * height) / 2;
 device_height = scale * height;
 }
 else {
 x_offset = (device_width - scale * width) / 2;
 device_width = scale * width;
 }

 RECT rect = { (LONG)x_offset, (LONG)y_offset, (LONG)(device_width + x_offset), (LONG)(device_height + y_offset) };
 Matrix matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(rect.left, rect.top, (int)device_width, (int)device_height,
 e_Rotation0);

 HBRUSH hBrush = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(0xff, 0xff, 0xff));
 FillRect(hdc_print, &rect, hBrush);
 DeleteObject(hBrush);

 Renderer render_print(hdc_print, WString::FromLocal(dev_string));
 render_print.EnableForPrint(true);
 RectI clip_rect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom);
 render_print.SetClipRect(&clip_rect);
 render_print.StartRender(page, matrix, NULL);

 // Inform the spooler that the page is complete.
 EndPage(hdc_print);
 }
 // Inform the driver that document has ended.
 EndDoc(hdc_print);
 // Release the device context.
 DeleteDC(hdc_print);

 }
 Library::Release();
}

How to clone bitmap with the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin?

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, WString file_path) {
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(file_path);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 Library::Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 Image image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 // Detect the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin.
 RectI rect = bitmap.DetectBBoxByColorDiffer(20, 64);
 if (rect.Height() > 0 && rect.Width() > 0) {
 Bitmap clone_bitmap = bitmap.Clone(&rect);
 WString output_file = L"detect_bbox_by color_differ_20_64_Foxit.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(clone_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to use Foxit PDF SDK to implement the conversion between OFD file and PDF file and to render OFD page.

#include <iostream>
#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
#include<direct.h>
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#endif

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/conversion/fs_convert.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/ofd/fs_ofddoc.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/ofd/fs_ofdpage.h"
#include "../../../include/addon/ofd/fs_ofdrenderer.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace addon::ofd;
using namespace addon::conversion;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 String ofd_resource_path = "";
 error_code = Library::InitializeOFDEngine(ofd_resource_path);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 {
 OFDConvertParam convert_param;
 // Convert OFD document to PDF document.
 Convert::FromOFD(L"input.ofd", L"", output_directory + L"output.pdf", convert_param);
 // Convert PDF document to OFD document.
 Convert::ToOFD(L"input.pdf", L"", output_directory + L"output.ofd", convert_param);
 }

 // Render OFD document to bitmap.
 {
 OFDDoc doc(L"demo.ofd", L"");
 OFDPage ofd_page = doc.GetPage(0);
 // Get the size of the page.
 float w = ofd_page.GetWidth();
 float h = ofd_page.GetHeight();
 Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap((int)w, (int)h, Bitmap::e_DIBArgb, NULL, 0);
 RectI fRect(0, (int)h, (int)w, 0);
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, &fRect);
 // Get the display matrix of the page.
 Matrix matrix_1 = ofd_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int)w, (int)h, CommonDefines::e_Rotation0);

 OFDRenderer ofd_render(bitmap);

 Progressive progressive = ofd_render.StartRender(ofd_page, matrix_1);
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(L"renderBitmap.bmp");
 ofd_page.Release();
 doc.Release();
 }

 Library::ReleaseOFDEngine();
 Library::Release();
}

---

How to async load pdf document?

#include <stdio.h>
#include "include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "include/common/fs_render.h"
#include "include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

struct DownloadHintDataInfo {
 DownloadHintDataInfo(int64 offset, int64 size, bool is_downloaded) {
 this->offset = offset;
 this->size = size;
 this->is_downloaded = is_downloaded;
 }
 int64 offset;
 int64 size;
 bool is_downloaded;
};
class AsyncFileRead : public foxit::common::file::AsyncReaderCallback {
public:
 AsyncFileRead()
 : file_(NULL)
 , is_large_file_(false) {}
 ~AsyncFileRead() {
 hint_data_record_.clear();
 }
 bool LoadFile(const wchar_t* file_path, bool is_large_file = false) {
#if defined(_WIN32) || (_WIN64)
 fopen_s(&file_, String::FromUnicode(file_path), "rb");
#else
 file_ = fopen(String::FromUnicode(file_path), "rb");
#endif
 if (!file_) return false;
 is_large_file_ = is_large_file;
 return true;
 }
 FILESIZE GetSize() {
 if (is_large_file_) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
 _fseeki64(file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 long long size_long = _ftelli64(file_);
#else
 fseeko(file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 long long size_long = ftello(file_);
#endif
 return size_long;
 } else {
 fseek(file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (int64)ftell(file_);
 }
 return 0;
 }
 FX_BOOL ReadBlock(void* buffer, FILESIZE offset, size_t size) {
 if (is_large_file_) {
#if defined(_WIN32)
 _fseeki64(file_, offset, SEEK_SET);
#else
 fseeko(file_, offset, SEEK_SET);
#endif
 long long read_size = fread(buffer, 1, size, file_);
 return read_size == size ? true : false;
 } else {
 if (0 != fseek(file_, static_cast<long>(offset), 0)) return false;
 if (0 == fread(buffer, size, 1, file_)) return false;
 return true;
 }
 return false;
 }
 void Release() {
 if (file_) fclose(file_);
 file_ = NULL;
 delete this;
 }
 virtual bool IsDataAvail(int64 offset, size_t size) {
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(offset, size, false);
 }
 virtual bool AddDownloadHint(int64 offset, size_t size) {
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(offset, size, true);
 }
protected:
 bool CheckRecordDownloaded(int64 offset, int64 size, bool to_download) {
 for (size_t i = 0; i < hint_data_record_.size(); i++) {
 DownloadHintDataInfo data_info = hint_data_record_[i];
 if (offset > (data_info.offset + data_info.size)) continue;
 if (offset + size < data_info.offset) continue;
 if (offset >= data_info.offset && (offset + size) <= (data_info.offset + data_info.size)) {
 if (to_download) data_info.is_downloaded = true;
 return data_info.is_downloaded;
 }
 if (offset >= data_info.offset && offset < (data_info.offset + data_info.size) && (offset + size) > (data_info.offset + data_info.size)) {
 if (to_download) data_info.is_downloaded = true;
 if (!data_info.is_downloaded) return data_info.is_downloaded;
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(data_info.offset + data_info.size + 1, size - 1 - (data_info.offset + data_info.size - offset), to_download);
 }
 if (offset < data_info.offset && (offset + size) >= data_info.offset && (offset + size) <= (data_info.offset + data_info.size)) {
 if (to_download) data_info.is_downloaded = true;
 if (!data_info.is_downloaded) return data_info.is_downloaded;
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(offset, data_info.offset - 1 - offset, to_download);
 }
 if (offset < data_info.offset && (offset + size) > (data_info.offset + data_info.size)) {
 if (to_download) data_info.is_downloaded = true;
 if (!data_info.is_downloaded) return data_info.is_downloaded;
 if (CheckRecordDownloaded(offset, data_info.offset - 1 - offset, to_download))
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(data_info.offset + data_info.size + 1, size - 1 - (data_info.offset - offset + data_info.size), to_download);
 else return false;
 }
 }
 if (to_download) {
 hint_data_record_.push_back(DownloadHintDataInfo new_info(offset, size, true));
 return true;
 }
 return false;
 }
private:
 std::vector<DownloadHintDataInfo> hint_data_record_;
 FILE* file_;
 bool is_large_file_;
};
int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
 Library::Initialize("", "");
 {
 AsyncFileRead* file_read = new AsyncFileRead();
 file_read->LoadFile(L"Sample.pdf");
 PDFDoc doc(file_read, true);
 ErrorCode code = foxit::e_ErrDataNotReady;
 while (code == foxit::e_ErrDataNotReady)
 code = doc.Load();
 PDFPage page;
 code = foxit::e_ErrDataNotReady;
 while (code == foxit::e_ErrDataNotReady) {
 try {
 page = doc.GetPage(0);
 break;
 } catch (Exception e) {
 code = e.GetErrCode();
 }
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
 return 0;
}

how to reflow pdf page and render as bitmap
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_reflowpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_render.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

// Fixed bitmap size, just to simulate split screen situation.
void ReflowContinuous(PDFDoc doc) {
 RectF margin = RectF(50, 30, 30, 30);
 PointF size = PointF(480, 800);
 float display_height = size.y - margin.top - margin.bottom;
 Bitmap bitmap(static_cast<int>(size.x), static_cast<int>(size.y), foxit::common::Bitmap::e_DIBArgb, NULL, 0);
 float offset_y = 0;
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();

 int bitmap_index = 0;

 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 ReflowPage reflow_page(page);
 // Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow page.
 reflow_page.SetLineSpace(0);
 reflow_page.SetScreenMargin(static_cast<int>(margin.left), static_cast<int>(margin.top),
 static_cast<int>(margin.right), static_cast<int>(margin.bottom));
 reflow_page.SetScreenSize(size.x, size.y);
 reflow_page.SetZoom(100);
 reflow_page.SetParseFlags(ReflowPage::e_WithImage);

 reflow_page.SetTopSpace(offset_y);

 // Parse reflow page.
 reflow_page.StartParse(NULL);
 float content_height = reflow_page.GetContentHeight();
 float content_width = reflow_page.GetContentWidth();
 // Render reflow page.
 Renderer renderer(bitmap, false);
 foxit::Matrix matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int)content_width, (int)content_height, foxit::common::Rotation::e_Rotation0);
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, NULL);
 }
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 ReflowContinuous(doc);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to flatten a pdf without annotations
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"annotations.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.StartParse(pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);
 // Flatten a PDF page without annotations
 page.Flatten(true, PDFPage::e_FlattenNoAnnot);
 }

 WString flatten_noannot = L"annotations_flatten_noannot.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(flatten_noannot, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to create layer tree
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdflayer.h"

using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* key = "";

{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Create layer tree
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 LayerTree layertree = LayerTree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.GetRootNode();
 root = layertree.GetRootNode();
 int child_count = root.GetChildrenCount();
 root.AddChild(0, L"AddedLayerNode", true);
 root.AddChild(0, L"AddedNode", false);
 doc.SaveAs(L"create_layer_tree.pdf");
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to set all the layer nodes information
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_render.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdflayer.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

void SetAllLayerNodesInformation(LayerNode layer_node) {
 if (layer_node.HasLayer()) {
 layer_node.SetDefaultVisible(true);
 layer_node.SetExportUsage(LayerTree::e_StateUndefined);
 layer_node.SetViewUsage(LayerTree::e_StateOFF);
 LayerPrintData print_data("subtype_print", LayerTree::e_StateON);
 layer_node.SetPrintUsage(print_data);
 LayerZoomData zoom_data(1, 10);
 layer_node.SetZoomUsage(zoom_data);
 WString new_name = WString(L"[View_OFF_Print_ON_Export_Undefined]") + layer_node.GetName();
 layer_node.SetName(new_name);
 }
 int count = layer_node.GetChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.GetChild(i);
 SetAllLayerNodesInformation(child);
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Load PDF document.
 PDFDoc doc(L"OCTest_src.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 LayerTree layertree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.GetRootNode();

 // Set new information.
 SetAllLayerNodesInformation(root);
 doc.SaveAs(L"new_layers.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNormal);

 Library::Release();
 }
}

---

how to check paging seal signature information
#include <iostream>
#include <time.h>
#include "../../../include/pdf/annots/fs_annot.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_image.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_signature.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace objects;
using namespace annots;
using namespace file;

#include "../../../include/openssl/rsa.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/evp.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/objects.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/x509.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/err.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pem.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/ssl.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs12.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/rand.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs7.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/stack.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/ts.h"
#include "../../../include/openssl/pkcs7.h"

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

void CheckPagingSealSignatureInfo(PDFDoc pdf_doc) {
 int signature_count = pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount();
 if (signature_count < 1) {
 printf("No signature in current PDF file.\r\n");
 return;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < signature_count; i++) {
 printf("Signature index: %d\r\n", i);
 Signature signature = pdf_doc.GetSignature(i);
 if (signature.IsEmpty()) continue;
 if (signature.GetSignatureType() != Signature::e_SignatureTypePagingSeal) continue;

 bool is_signed = signature.IsSigned();
 printf("Signed?:%s\r\n", is_signed ? "true" : "false");
 uint32 sig_state = signature.GetState();
 annots::Widget widget_annot = signature.GetControl(0).GetWidget();

 String filter = signature.GetFilter();
 printf("Filter:%s\r\n", (const char*)filter);
 String sub_filter = signature.GetSubFilter();
 printf("Sub-filter:%s\r\n", (const char*)sub_filter);
 if (is_signed) {
 DateTime sign_time = signature.GetSignTime();
 }
 WString key_value;
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameSigner);
 printf("Signer:%s\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(key_value));
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameLocation);
 printf("Location:%s\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(key_value));
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameReason);
 printf("Reason:%s\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(key_value));
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameContactInfo);
 printf("Contact Info:%s\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(key_value));
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameDN);
 printf("DN:%s\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(key_value));
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature::e_KeyNameText);
 printf("Text:%s\r\n", (const char*)String::FromUnicode(key_value));
 }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc pdf_doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 interform::Form form(pdf_doc);
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(NULL, false, NULL);
 // Check information of existed paging seal signature(s) in PDF file if there's any paging seal signature in the PDF file.
 CheckPagingSealSignatureInfo(pdf_doc);
 }

 Library::Release();
}

---

how to reflow pdf page and change the size depend on the size of reflow page
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_reflowpage.h"
#include "../../../include/common/fs_render.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
const void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, int index, WString file_name) {
 RectF margin = RectF(50, 30, 30, 30);
 PointF size = PointF(480, 800);
 RectI rect(0, 0, static_cast<int>(size.x), static_cast<int>(margin.top));
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, &rect);
 rect = RectI(0, static_cast<int>(size.y - margin.bottom), static_cast<int>(size.x), static_cast<int>(size.y));
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, &rect);
 Image image;
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);

 WString save_path;
 WString sIndex;
 sIndex.Format((FX_LPCWSTR)L"%d", index);
 save_path = L"reflow" + file_name + sIndex + L".bmp";
 image.SaveAs(save_path);
}

// The change for the size of the picture depends on the size of the content of reflow page.
void ReflowSingle(PDFDoc doc) {
 RectF margin = RectF(50, 30, 30, 30);
 PointF size = PointF(480, 800);
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse PDF page.
 page.StartParse(foxit::pdf::PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 ReflowPage reflow_page(page);
 // Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow page.
 reflow_page.SetLineSpace(0);
 reflow_page.SetScreenMargin(static_cast<int>(margin.left), static_cast<int>(margin.top),
 static_cast<int>(margin.right), static_cast<int>(margin.bottom));
 reflow_page.SetScreenSize(size.x, size.y);
 reflow_page.SetZoom(100);
 reflow_page.SetParseFlags(ReflowPage::e_Normal);

 // Parse reflow page.
 reflow_page.StartParse(NULL);

 // Get actual size of content of reflow page. The content size does not contain the margin.
 float content_width = reflow_page.GetContentWidth();
 float content_height = reflow_page.GetContentHeight();

 // Create a bitmap for rendering the reflow page. The bitmap size contains the margin.
 Bitmap bitmap(static_cast<int>(content_width + margin.left + margin.right),
 static_cast<int>(content_height + margin.top + margin.bottom), foxit::common::Bitmap::e_DIBArgb, NULL, 0);
 bitmap.FillRect(0xFFFFFFFF, NULL);

 // Render reflow page.
 Renderer renderer(bitmap, false);
 foxit::Matrix matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, content_width, content_height, Rotation::e_Rotation0);
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, NULL);
 WString file_name = L"_single_";
 SaveBitmap(bitmap, i, file_name);
 }

}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();
 ReflowSingle(doc);
 }
 Library::Release();
}

how to move page
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/graphics/fs_pdfgraphicsobject.h"
using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;
using namespace graphics;

//user enters sn and key
static const char* sn = "..";
static const char* key = "..";

bool MovePages()
{
 WString input_file = L"page_organization_123.pdf";
 WString input_file1 = L"page_organization_abc.pdf";
 // Move page
 PDFDoc doc = PDFDoc(input_file);
 interform::Form form(doc);
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load();
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 int count = doc.GetPageCount();
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 doc.MovePageTo(page, doc.GetPageCount() - 1);
 WString output_file1 = L"move_first_page_to_last.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file1, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNormal);

 doc = PDFDoc(input_file1);
 code = doc.Load();
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 Range page_set;
 for (int i = 0; i < count / 2; i++)
 page_set.AddSingle(2 * i);
 doc.MovePagesTo(page_set, doc.GetPageCount() - 1);
 WString output_file = L"move_pages.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNormal);
 return true;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 MovePages();
 }

 Library::Release();
}

How to create a root node for bookmark?

#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_filespec.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_bookmark.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;

 Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 doc.Load();

 //Get bookmark root node or Create new bookmark root node.
 Bookmark root = doc.GetRootBookmark();
 if (root.IsEmpty())
 root = doc.CreateRootBookmark();
 for (int i = 0; i < doc.GetPageCount(); i += 2) {
 Destination dest = Destination::CreateFitPage(doc, i);
 CFX_WideString ws_title;
 ws_title.Format((FX_LPCWSTR)L"A bookmark to a page (index: %d)", i);
 Bookmark child = root.Insert(ws_title,
 foxit::pdf::Bookmark::e_PosLastChild);
 child.SetDestination(dest);
 child.SetColor(i * 0xF68C21);
 }
 doc.SaveAs(L"bookmark_add.pdf", PDFDoc::e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library::Release();
 return err_ret;
}

how to add bitmap watermark
#include <time.h>
#include <iostream>
#include "../../../include/common/fs_common.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfdoc.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_pdfpage.h"
#include "../../../include/pdf/fs_watermark.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace foxit;
using namespace foxit::common;
using foxit::common::Library;
using namespace pdf;

void AddBitmapWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page, WString bitmap_file) {
 WatermarkSettings settings;
 settings.flags = WatermarkSettings::e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings::e_FlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0.f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.f;
 settings.opacity = 60;
 settings.position = common::e_PosCenterLeft;
 settings.rotation = 90.f;

 Image image(bitmap_file);
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);
 settings.scale_x = page.GetHeight() * 1.0f / bitmap.GetWidth();
 settings.scale_y = settings.scale_x;
 Watermark watermark(doc, bitmap, settings);
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
}

static const char* sn = "";
static const char* key = "";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 //initialize foxit pdf sdk
 foxit::ErrorCode code = Library::Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc(L"AboutFoxit.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load();

 if (error_code != foxit::e_ErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 page.StartParse(PDFPage::e_ParsePageNormal, NULL, false);

 WString wm_image = L"sdk.png";
 AddBitmapWatermark(doc, page, L"watermark.bmp");
 }
 }
 Library::Release();
}
